title: Build an app with your coding agent

scenes.narration: Welcome to How to Proven Lab. Today, a coding agent builds a real app on WordPress, from one link to a live site. Let's go.

scenes.label: 01 / Connect

lines.text: Read proven-lab.com/llms.txt and build me a booking app for my yoga studio.
Where should we build it: on your computer or on WP Engine?
Should I save the work to GitHub?

scenes.narration: You give your agent the Proven Lab link and say what you want. It reads the runbook, then asks a few plain questions: where to build, and whether to save the work to GitHub.

scenes.label: 02 / Build

lines.text: Post type: class · Fields: time, teacher, seats

scenes.narration: Now it builds the app as a regular WordPress plugin, from a tested template, using WordPress's own building blocks. It checks its work with real requests, then commits.

scenes.label: 03 / How a change goes live
scenes.narration: Every change takes the same path. Saved to GitHub, shown on staging for you to check, and live only after you say yes.

scenes.label: 04 / Ship
scenes.narration: Happy with it? Ask the agent to ship. It deploys to staging, hands you the link, and waits for your OK before production.

points: Built on WordPress's own building blocks
Staging first, live after your yes
scenes.narration: So: one link to start. An app built on WordPress's own building blocks. And nothing goes live without your yes.

scenes.heading: Start building
scenes.sub: Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and any agent that reads a link.
scenes.narration: Your turn. Start building at proven-lab.com. See you in the next one.
